purpose: Focused TPS specialist effectiveness check under the frozen production BRIDGE policy

comparison.before: same production system with Family/Domain specialist contribution disabled
comparison.after: full production system with frozen TPS specialist enabled

test_set.selection_scope: fixed 50-query TPS-focused subset preserved from the production run; all 50 queries are confirmed to receive non-zero TPS specialist weight under the frozen production runtime

metrics.aggregation: query-macro; best positive rank per reaction query

interpretation: The TPS Family/Domain specialist produces a measurable MRR gain on a TPS-specific, production-gated benchmark. This is a conditional specialist-effectiveness result, not a replacement for the broad overall benchmark.
